whatIsOpenDjed.description: Open DJED is a transparent, community-driven web app for interacting with the DJED algorithmic stablecoin on Cardano, built entirely open source by Artifi Labs. It recreates the original DJED experience with full protocol compatibility - offering a more reliable, accessible, and auditable alternative.
